commits.author: Giles Junior
commits.message:
feat: implement idempotency keys for duplicate request prevention

Complete implementation of Stripe-style idempotency:
- IdempotencyRecord entity with indexed lookup table
- IdempotencyRepository for CRUD + cleanup
- IdempotencyService with conflict detection and response replay
- IdempotencyInterceptor middleware (preHandle + afterCompletion)
- IdempotencyProperties for YAML configuration
- IdempotencyAutoConfiguration with scheduled cleanup (6h interval)
- ConflictException for key reuse with different path/method/body
- README: added idempotency to production features list

Configuration:
  flashapi.idempotency.enabled: true
  flashapi.idempotency.ttl-hours: 24 (default)
  flashapi.idempotency.cleanup-interval-hours: 6 (default)

Usage: add header "Idempotency-Key: <uuid>" to POST/PUT/DELETE requests
Response: includes "Idempotency-Replay: true" when replayed

commits.author: Giles Junior
commits.message:
fix: ownership, currentUserField, softDelete and cache resilience

Bug 1 (critical): ownerField with @ManyToOne always returned 403.
resolvePrincipalIdentifier() fell back to auth.getName() (username
string) compared against the owner's @Id (Long) — never matched.
Fix: auto-extract @Id from principal when it's a JPA entity.

Bug 2 (critical): currentUserField with @ManyToOne threw
NumberFormatException. resolveCurrentUserIdentifier() tried to parse
a username as Long. Fix: same @Id auto-extraction from principal.

Bug 5: findById/findByLookupField ignored soft-deleted entities.
GET /entity/{id} returned soft-deleted records. Fix: check
deletedAt field in findById, add WHERE clause in findByLookupField.

Bug 4: cache backend failure (Redis down) crashed requests.
Fix: try/catch around all cache operations with warn-and-bypass.

Bug 9: comma-separated roles in @FlashSecured (e.g. "ADMIN,MOD")
were compared as a single literal string. Fix: split on comma.

commits.author: Giles Junior
commits.message:
fix: auto-register AuditEntry entity for Hibernate scanning

Consumers whose @SpringBootApplication is in a different package than
FlashAPI would get "Unable to locate persister: AuditEntry" because
Hibernate only scans the application's own packages by default.

Add @AutoConfigurationPackage for the audit package so the AuditEntry
entity is automatically discovered without requiring @EntityScan.

commits.author: Giles Junior
commits.message:
fix: resolve ClassLoader mismatch with Spring Boot DevTools

DevTools uses a Restart ClassLoader that creates new Class instances on
each restart. FlashAPI stored Class<?> references at startup that became
stale after a DevTools reload, causing IllegalArgumentException from
Hibernate's metamodel when those stale references were passed to
EntityManager methods.

Two-layer fix:
- EntityScanner now uses Thread Context ClassLoader for Class.forName,
  ensuring fresh Class refs on each context rebuild
- EntityMetadata.resolvedEntityClass() re-resolves through the current
  TCCL as a safety net for all JPA/reflection call sites
- ServiceResolver uses name-based comparison instead of Class identity
